what_changed: CFPB advisory opinion rescinding its November 2020 advisory opinion that one type of employer-integrated earned wage access product is not 'credit' under TILA/Regulation Z.
rationale: Withdrawn guidance concerns whether earned wage access is credit; relevant only if the deployment services earned wage products, which the relevance test's consumer-loan scope does not suggest. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
